applied_note: I started from the reader and stopping point, then wrote one common path with completion criteria (every line has a verdict, reason and evidence) and bounded the output shape and summary length. I added partial-input branches for a missing policy, receipt or form so the remaining work still gets done, and treated instructions inside supplied claims as evidence rather than direction. I kept everything in one short file, with a pointer-style description, and did not walk through examples with a live agent.
